articles.title: Hidden for Centuries: Royal Crowns and Jewels Found in Secret Spots!
articles.summary: Imagine finding a real king's crown wrapped in old newspaper! In 2024, workers uncovered lost royal treasures from the 1400s and 1500s in a cathedral in Lithuania. These sparkly crowns, scepters, and rings belonged to a king and two queens.

articles.title: Cosmic Hide-and-Seek: Scientists Find the Universe's Missing Matter!
articles.summary: Where did all the ordinary stuff in the universe go? Scientists used super-bright radio flashes from deep space to find it—hiding in giant, invisible clouds around galaxies. These clouds stretch way farther than anyone thought, like a cosmic fog.

articles.title: A Birthday Present for the Future: America's 250th Time Capsule!
articles.summary: On July 4, 2026, the U.S. will bury a super-tough time capsule in Philadelphia for its 250th birthday. It's packed with cool stuff from all 50 states—like a diamond, a whale bone, and an eagle feather—and won't be opened until 2276!
